opening.argument: The promotion leads with a concrete earnings promise: “Earn ₹ 500 per day by Playing Ludo,” while also claiming that the app can provide earnings of up to Rs 5,000. Viewers are directed to download the app and register through the creator's referral code. The advertised flow involves monetary game amounts from 10 to 10,000 rupees, presents withdrawal as immediate, and displays a 2.7-rupee transaction fee deducted before confirmation. Although an educational disclaimer provides countercontext, the claimed earnings and payout remain unverified. Taken together, the referral-driven promotion, paid game flow, earnings claims, and fee-bearing withdrawal process establish a low-barrier offer to acquire rewards or assets without verified support.
